facts.text: All students take Conversatio, a required year-long interdisciplinary humanities program rooted in the Catholic, Benedictine tradition.

sources.title: The Humanities: Conversatio - Saint Anselm College
sources.quote: Conversatio is the foundational shared learning experience for every Saint Anselm student. This year-long interdisciplinary course provides students with an intellectual orientation to studies in the liberal arts and acquaints them with the distinctive value of those studies
